text:
emily-fin: Morning team — ZenHealth batch invoice run at 07:40. 2 of 6 cards declined with processor code `DO_NOT_HONOR`. Need quick triage: retries, comms, and whether to offer short-term terms.

tony-payments: Please paste last4 and payment IDs. I want to see if they hit our primary acquirer only.

emily-fin: last4: 5567, 8899. payment ids pay_d02a..., pay_d02a... (DMing fulls).

billing-bot: [system] payment.failed events=2 reason=card_decline code=DO_NOT_HONOR.

rachel-support: Customer filed a ticket asking "What happened to today's billing?" They asked us not to retry without confirmation.

tony-payments: Plan: 1) Stop auto-retries for these tokens. 2) Offer invoice link + ACH instructions. 3) If they need, give a one-time 7-day extension (no more than $7k). 4) Log everything.

omar-ops: +1 on 7-day extension. Add metadata temp_terms=7d_7k and notify collections at day 8.

sue-legal: Good. Use wording "issuing bank declined" in comms and avoid presuming fraud. Note any credit commitments in Zendesk.

emily-fin: Draft customer message:

Hi ZenHealth — we attempted to process your scheduled invoice but two cards were declined by the issuing bank; no funds were captured. We can pause retries and either send an invoice link with ACH instructions or retry with a different card if you provide one. If helpful, we can place this invoice on a one-time 7-day extension while payment is arranged. Please reply with your preference.

If we don’t hear back in 3 business days we’ll follow our collections flow.

— Redwood Billing

rachel-support: Sending that now in ticket #4902 and asking if they'd like ACH. Customer replied: "Please send ACH, we'll initiate."

tony-payments: Cancelling retries and starting ACH microdeposit flow. Command (internal): /payments microdeposit --acct acct_zen --amounts 0.05,0.12 --expiry 7d

billing-bot: [system] invoice.link created https://redwood-invoices/local/ln_zen123 (expires 7 days). microdeposit.initiated acct=acct_zen status=pending

emily-fin: Updated billing note: retries paused; temp_terms=7d_7k approved (omar-ops); invoice link sent; ACH flow started. Revisit in 7 days.

sue-legal: Reminder: do not paste bank account info in Slack. Use secure forms.

omar-ops: Thanks team. Ping me if they request longer terms.

emily-fin: Closing thread — status: customer opted ACH, microdeposits initiated, retries paused, 7-day extension applied. Will reconcile when payment clears.
